title: Stop at a black line
summary: Drive until the colour sensor sees black.

steps.title: Open the starter program
steps.text: The robot drives forward and stops the moment its colour sensor (port B) sees the black line.

steps.title: Why it works
steps.text: Instead of guessing a distance, the robot watches the mat. It does not matter if it started a little early or late: it always stops at the line. Using a sensor to decide when to stop is called closed loop.

steps.title: Try it 1
steps.text: Make it faster by changing the speed to 60. Does it still stop on the line?

steps.title: Try it 2
steps.text: After it stops, add a move backward 5 cm so it lines up just before the line.

steps.title: Try it 3
steps.text: With Realism on Realistic, press ▶×5. Compare the end points with Drive a square.

steps.title: Take the challenge
steps.text: Start the challenge, then press ▶︎×5. The simulator checks your runs for you.
